title.en: An Act Appropriating the Amount of Two Million Four Hundred Forty-Eight Thousand Three Hundred Forty-Four Pesos as Additional Funds for the Operation of the Bureau of Prisons During the Period from July First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Eight to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Nine
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Amount of Two Million Four Hundred Forty-Eight Thousand Three Hundred Forty-Four Pesos as Additional Funds for the Operation of the Bureau of Prisons During the Period from July First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Eight to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Nine

text.en:
The following sums are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated as additional appropriation for the operation of the Bureau of Prisons during the period from July 1, 1958 to June 30, 1959:
GENERAL FUND
I. - PERSONAL SERVICES 1 One hundred fifty guards at ₱1,716 ₱257.400.00 2 Two medical officers at ₱4,632 9,264.00 3 Three penal psychiatrists at ₱4,632 13,896.00 4 Five guidance-counselors at ₱3,108 15,540.00 5 One radiologist :
4,632.00 6 Six nurses at ₱2.304 13,824.00 7 Five penal institutions teachers at ₱2,196 10,980.00 8 Seven clerks I at ₱1,800 12,600.00 9 Six nursing attendants at ₱1,548 9,288.00 Total for personal services ₱347,424.00 =========== II.- MAINTENANCE AND OTHER OPERATING EXPENSES 1 Supplies and materials ₱2,000,920.00 2 Sundry expenses 68,000.00 Total for maintenance and other operating expenses ₱2,068,920.00 =========== III.- FURNITURE AND EQUIPMENT 1 Equipment outlay ₱32.000.00 Total for furniture and equipment ₱32,000.00 ========= IV.- SUMMARY Total for personal services ₱347,424.00 Total for maintenance and other operating expenses 2,068,920.00 Total for furniture and equipment 32,000.00 Total additional appropriation for current operating expenditures for the Bureau of Prisons ₱2,448,344.00 ===========

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 13, 1958.
